messages:
raj: hitting a customer bug — streaming JSON mode cuts off mid-object, app throws parseerror
lucy: sorry about that, can you paste request id + small repro?
raj: request_id=rid_8f7c3, using SSE endpoint /v1/responses?mode=json-stream, curl below
raj: ```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"input":"{...}","json_mode":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses
```
lucy: thanks, sending to eng-runtime, can you share last bytes you received? any proxies in front?
raj: we saw final chunk ends with `,"choices":[{...` and then connection FIN. client shows 200 then no more data
matt: looping in eng-runtime, possible TCP FIN from upstream. raj do you have curl --verbose output?
raj: attached snippet: `* recv 1024 bytes` then `* Connection closed by peer` line
matt: could be our keepalive timeout on certain proxies when payload idle. which region?
raj: eu-west-1
matt: ok we'll grep logs for rid_8f7c3, also can you repro with `--no-buffer`? sometimes chunking change
raj: tried with node fetch and curl, same result. happens ~1/10 streams
lucy: marking P2, asking infra for packet capture or proxy logs. also checking billing — customer retried and incurred extra token usage
devex: sharing a quick mitigation: switch to non-streaming JSON (full response) until fixed, or wrap with top-level array in consumer to tolerate incomplete trailing
matt: found suspects: nginx upstream with `proxy_read_timeout` at 60s, and our per-request idle-kv-cache flush at 59s. aligning timeouts may fix
lucy: thanks. raj can you hold on while we deploy fix to increase idle window and add defensive trailing brace on client? we'll follow up with repro logs
raj: ok, thx. keep me posted :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy started: eng-runtime/patch/stream-idle-adjust (job 4321)
matt: deployed patch to staging, can you test staging rid_8f7c3-stg?
raj: testing now... staging looks good, no chop in 50 runs
lucy: closing escalation for now, will monitor 24h and follow up on billing credit if extra usage was due to retries
